sources.title: Shipping policy
sources.content: Demo Atelier sells homewares. Standard delivery in mainland France is free for orders over €600. Below that threshold, delivery costs €12. This policy applies to standard delivery only.

decisions.statement: Use €450 for free standard delivery in mainland France until the website is corrected.

reviewSources.title: Shipping policy
reviewSources.content: Demo Atelier sells homewares. Standard delivery in mainland France is free for orders over €300. Below that threshold, delivery costs €12. This policy applies to standard delivery only.

context.text: The shipping policy covers standard delivery within mainland France only.

links.label: Shipping policy
links.description: Standard delivery terms for mainland France; the free-delivery threshold needs review.

output.explanation: The free-delivery threshold needs review, so the guide does not state an amount. The shipping policy remains available as a resource.
